# Social Networks - study material

> Social Networks (NPTEL, IIT Ropar, Prof. S. R. S. Iyengar). All 12 weeks (166 lectures): hand-made study notes, assignment/question papers with solutions, and full lecture transcripts. Every item is available as plain text (best for AI chat) and as the original PDF/HTML. Notes are a condensed re-teach; the transcript is the authority.

Website: https://pml2405.github.io/social-networks/
Repository: https://github.com/PML2405/social-networks
All notes in one file: https://pml2405.github.io/social-networks/text/all-notes.txt

---
